meta.title: B2B Marketplace
meta.description: Wholesale and clearance stock from verified businesses near you.

footer.sampleNotice: This is an early preview. Offers are real and checked by reviewers, but ordering and payment are not open yet.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.description: This page could not be shown. Please try again.

home.tagline: Wholesale and clearance stock from verified businesses near you.

assistant.title: Ask the assistant
assistant.body: Say what you need in English, Telugu or Hindi, for example "20 boxes of detergent near Vijayawada". The assistant turns it into search filters.
assistant.note: The assistant only chooses filters. Every offer you see comes from real sellers; it never makes up products, prices or stock.
assistant.label: What do you need?
assistant.privacy: Your question is sent to Google's Gemini service to understand it. Please don't include names, phone numbers or other personal details.

home.tilesHeading: What would you like to do?
home.offersIntro: Real stock from sellers, checked by our reviewers before it is shown.
home.noOffers: No offers yet. Check back soon.
home.offersUnavailable: Offers could not be loaded right now. Please try again in a moment.

sell.title: Sell your stock
sell.intro: List surplus or clearance stock and reach verified buyers.
sell.noBusinessDescription: Listings belong to a business. It takes about two minutes.

wizard.title: List new stock
wizard.intro: Answer a few short questions. You can go back at any time.

product.noProducts: You have no products yet. Add a new one.
product.name: Product name
product.gtinHint: The digits under the barcode, if there is one

batch.noWarehouses: Add a warehouse first: every batch is kept in one.
batch.batchNumberHint: Copy it exactly from the pack
batch.expiresOnHint: Copy it exactly from the label. A reviewer checks it against your photo.
batch.mrpHint: As printed on the pack, including taxes

price.moqHint: The smallest quantity a buyer can order
price.tiersHint: Price per unit before GST. Add lower prices for larger orders if you like.
price.addTier: Add a price for a larger order
price.firstTierNote: The first price starts at the minimum order.
price.clearanceReason: Why are you clearing this stock?

wizard.saveHint: Next you will add photos and send the listing for review. Nothing is shown to buyers yet.
wizard.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number above zero.
wizard.invalidMoney: Enter an amount in rupees, like 45 or 45.50.
wizard.notAllowed: Only owners and managers can list stock.

auth.loginIntro: Use your Google account. We only receive your name and your verified email address.
auth.privacyNote: We never see your Google password.

errors.expired: Sign-in took too long. Please try again.
errors.failed: We could not sign you in. Please try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

account.title: My account
account.noBusinesses: You are not part of any business yet.

business.createIntro: Tell us about your business. You can add verification documents later.

fields.legalNameHint: As on your GST certificate or shop licence
fields.gstinHint: 15 characters, as printed on your GST certificate

business.inviteHint: They accept the invitation after signing in with this email.
business.invited: Invitation created. Ask them to sign in with this email to accept it.

errors.invalid: Please check the details and try again.
errors.gstinTaken: Another business already uses this GSTIN.
errors.alreadyInvited: This person already has an open invitation or is already a member.
errors.notAllowed: Your role does not allow this.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.warehouseNameTaken: You already have a warehouse with this name.
errors.barcodeTaken: A product with this barcode is already in the catalogue.
errors.batchNumberTaken: You already have this batch number for this product.
errors.alreadyListed: This batch already has a listing.
errors.notReady: Some checks do not pass yet. See the list above.
errors.alreadyDecided: This listing is no longer waiting for review.
errors.photoProblem: This photo could not be used. Upload a clear JPEG or PNG under 5 MB.
errors.photoConflict: This photo cannot be added: it is already there, the batch has 6 photos, or it is in review.

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.intro: The places where your stock is kept. Each stock batch belongs to one warehouse.
warehouses.none: No warehouses yet. Add the place where your stock is kept.

fields.name: Warehouse name
fields.nameHint: A short name you will recognise, such as Main godown

warehouses.readOnly: Only owners and managers can add or change warehouses.

visibility.PUBLIC: Public: buyers see your business name
visibility.CONFIDENTIAL: Confidential: your name is hidden until a deal

problems.SHELF_LIFE_TOO_SHORT: Less than 30 days are left before the date on the pack.
problems.PACK_PHOTO_MISSING: Add a photo of the front of the pack.
problems.LABEL_PHOTO_MISSING: Add a photo of the label showing the date.
problems.MRP_MISSING: Enter the MRP printed on one pack.
problems.PRICE_ABOVE_MRP: With GST, one pack would cost more than its MRP. Lower the price.
problems.REGULATED_CATEGORY: This category cannot be sold yet.
problems.NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK: The minimum order is more than the stock in this batch.

listings.title: Listings
listings.none: No listings yet. Stock you list appears here.
listings.readOnly: Only owners and managers can create or change listings.
listings.photoFileHint: JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB. On a phone you can take it now. Location data is removed.
listings.ready: All checks pass. You can send it for review.
listings.inReviewNote: A reviewer is checking this listing. Withdraw it if you need to change the stock or photos.
listings.pausedNote: Paused: buyers cannot see this listing until you resume it.
listings.closedNote: Closed. You can list this batch again as a new listing.

review.title: Review queue
review.intro: Check each listing against its photos before buyers can see it. Oldest first.
review.notAllowed: Only platform reviewers can open the review queue.
review.noProblems: All automatic checks pass. Still compare the photos with the details.
review.reasonHint: The seller sees this. Say what to fix, for example: the expiry date in the photo is not readable.

offers.title: Offers
offers.intro: Clearance and surplus stock from businesses across India. Prices are per unit, before GST.
offers.queryPlaceholder: Product or brand, in any language
offers.maxOrderHint: What the smallest order would cost, before GST
offers.minDays: At least this many days left
offers.minDaysHint: Offers always have at least 30 days left
offers.none: No offers match. Try fewer filters or other words.
offers.unavailable: Offers could not be loaded right now. Please try again in a moment.
offers.invalidFilters: Some filters could not be used. Check the numbers and try again.
offers.quoteComingSoon: Ordering opens soon. You will be able to request a quote here.

assistant.noPlace: There are no offers in {place} yet, so all places are shown.
assistant.fallbackOff: The assistant isn't available right now, so we searched for your words instead.
assistant.fallbackBusy: The assistant is busy right now, so we searched for your words instead.
assistant.checkNote: The assistant only chose these filters. Remove any that are wrong.
